approval_ref: The active goal requires continued efficiency across RFI, Submittal and Email workflows; current pagination rebuilds the complete terminal-run index on every page request.
notes: Prove repeated terminal-run pages repeat the projected summary read before changing code.
Use only a bounded standard-library process-local cache; active runs remain uncached.
A successful workflow-classification correction must invalidate cached terminal indexes immediately; no parser, model or cost action may start.

Verified offline: terminal first/repeated/next pages build once instead of three times; two active requests read twice; correction invalidation exposes the fresh classification. Full gates passed with 660 Python, 24 UI and 11 deployment tests plus a 381-file manifest.
title: Reuse terminal workflow indexes across pagination
objective: Build a terminal analysis run's complete deterministic workflow index once across bounded pagination requests, while keeping active runs fresh and invalidating the cache after a reviewer classification correction.
